rationale: stable_hindcast_ensemble remains the strongest historical candidate with the lowest hindcast SMAPE (30.61), ahead of regime_damped_harmonic (33.82), robust_shape_analog (35.90), and robust_seasonal_level (38.58). No fold-level evidence shows that the ensemble has higher median error than a low-dispersion competitor. With no candidate-specific evidence favoring a runner-up or valid future-window adjustment, the final-round decision falls back to the strongest historical leader.
